requirements: Private MES and historian require an explicit secure private/on-prem connection boundary; QMS API, Azure Blob and cloud/private ERP replica must be evaluated separately.
Freshness differs by source: historian 5 min, MES 15 min, QMS 30 min, image metadata hourly, ERP cost daily, certified model hourly. Architecture must not flatten these into one schedule.

GRP-QA needs curated quality analysis, not raw secrets/admin. Plant managers are read-only consumers. SPN-MFG is a nonhuman least-privilege pipeline identity. Vendor access is exceptional, not default workspace membership.
Inspection images are large unstructured evidence; duplication must be justified.
Incidents: firewall/gateway break, token expiry, accidental Contributor grant. Each requires signal, owner, recovery, post-validation and communication.
All primary sources are cloud-accessible. Inventing an on-premises gateway is a design error unless a private/firewall requirement exists.
Clickstream is large external object storage; copy vs shortcut/reference must be justified from workload, latency, governance and cost.
External agency may see approved campaign aggregates but not CRM-identifiable detail; Contributor is not the default self-service solution.
Google/Meta 30 min, clickstream 15 min, CRM hourly, finance daily, model hourly: monitoring must preserve separate SLAs.
Incidents: API throttling, new CRM PII column, agency requests Contributor. Require backoff/partial-publish rule, governance/lineage impact and least-privilege alternative.
Booking SQL is private/on-prem and needs a secure connection boundary; flight API, partner SFTP, cloud event stream and Azure Blob do not automatically share that requirement.
Flight status has 5 min SLA and web events <5 min; booking transactions 10 min; partner/finance daily. Tightest freshness drives incident priority but not every source schedule.
Ops, finance and support require different detail; pipeline service identity is nonhuman least privilege; external partner gets no workspace by default.
Incidents: booking gateway outage, SFTP 8 hours late, flight API schema rename. Require stale-data/partial-publish decisions, schema quarantine/replay and consumer communication.
Architecture must distinguish operational availability from analytical reporting and avoid hidden paid-tenant click dependencies in the assessment.
